## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D2. This is audit backlog UX-16 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Every signed-in page · all roles · 768 and wider; bottom tabs under 768 keep working.
Findings and reviewers: F-18, F-22, and the cause of F-13 · reviewers B-07, B-12, B-28, C-08, C-09. Part 2 of 2 of audit backlog UX-16.
Rationale: Controls used once a day hold the most valuable row, Sign out sits beside Search, and this row is what overflowed on Azure dev at 768 and 375 px. Between 768 and 1279 px the navigation is unlabelled icons: a recognition problem for a receptionist on day one.
Proposed UX behaviour: The top bar is 48 px from 768 px up (56 on phones) and holds clinic name, patient search, the bell and the avatar that opens AccountMenu (name and role, language, my devices, change facility, sign out last). From 768 to 1279 px the rail is 72 px with the label under every icon. From 1280 px the labelled sidebar is 232 px and may be collapsed to the rail by the user's own choice only, remembered per user without storing anything about patients. On phones the account items are in More. The keyboard hint in the search field is wrapped left-to-right so Arabic no longer scrambles it. Navigation names and order do not change here.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, audit note 1; blueprint section 3.
Components and tokens affected: Uses AccountMenu, NavRailItem and Tooltip. Layout tokens for bar, rail and sidebar.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the shell components ticket (wave D1c). File ownership: AppShell.tsx, MorePage.tsx and the shell specs.
Clinical sign-off: Not required. Ruling 6: the account menu and rail labels are low-risk and may land before training.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low to medium: about 10 locators in 3 spec files move from header buttons into the menu.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Renaming or reordering navigation items (the names ticket, at a training boundary). (2) An icon-only rail by default (forbidden by ruling 8). (3) Rebuilding the shell: landmarks, skip link and breakpoints stay.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given any signed-in page at 768 and 375 px, when it loads, then page width equals viewport width and Sign out is reachable in at most two actions
- [ ] **AC2.** Given 1024 by 768 for each role, when the shell renders, then every navigation item shows its name as visible text under the icon
- [ ] **AC3.** Given 1440 px, when a user has never chosen, then the labelled sidebar shows; when they collapse it, then the labelled rail shows and the choice is kept on reload
- [ ] **AC4.** Given 1024 px and wider, when the top bar is measured, then it is 48 px tall and holds clinic, search, bell and avatar only
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the avatar button, when the menu is opened and closed by keyboard, then focus returns to the button and the skip link is still the first tab stop
- [ ] **AC6.** Given Arabic, when the shell renders, then it mirrors, the search key hint reads correctly, and axe finds no violation in English or Arabic
